crossRefs.note: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation, and is not able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,

translations.web: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation, and is not able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,
translations.bsb: Otherwise, if he lays the foundation and is unable to finish the work, everyone who sees it will ridicule him,
translations.kjv: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him,
translations.asv: Lest haply, when he hath laid a foundation, and is not able to finish, all that behold begin to mock him,
